_doc: Zack-D-style prototype 1 (AI stills). Fixed style + character sheet + seeds -> repeatable. {BOY}/{MAN}/{SET} are expanded by gen.py. Generated by .github/workflows/zack-images.yml (SDXL base 1.0 + SDXL-Lightning 4-step UNet, both CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M). Round 2: CLIP truncates at 77 tokens -> short style PREFIX first; 'chocolate syrup' renders the brown flood far better than 'molasses'.
